{"id":"ka0125","verbatim":"These guarantees are contingent obligations that could give rise to specified amounts of recourse against our Operating Partnership, should the special purpose property-owning subsidiaries be unable to satisfy certain obligations under otherwise non-recourse mortgage loans.","paraphrase":"These guarantees represent contingent liabilities that may result in specified recourse to our Operating Partnership if the special purpose entities that own our properties fail to meet certain duties under mortgage debt that is otherwise without recourse.","different_hard":"These guaranties are contingent obligations that could not give rise to any recourse against our Operating Partnership, even should the special purpose property-owning subsidiaries be unable to satisfy certain obligations under otherwise non-recourse mortgage loans."},
{"id":"ka0126","verbatim":"Among our current customers, we have identified seven that are sizable enough that the loss of any one would be significant.","paraphrase":"Of our present clients, we have found six whose size is such that losing any single one would have a significant impact.","different_hard":"Among our current customers, we have identified six that are sizable enough that the loss of any one would be immaterial."},
{"id":"ka0127","verbatim":"The DRA has reduced the reimbursement of certain products provided by the Company and significantly reduced reimbursement related to oxygen beginning in 2011.","paraphrase":"Beginning in 2009, the DRA cut its repayments for some products the Company furnishes and made a deep reduction in reimbursement tied to oxygen.","different_hard":"The DRA has increased the reimbursement of certain products provided by the Company and significantly increased reimbursement related to oxygen beginning in 2009."},
{"id":"ka0128","verbatim":"In addition, while we cannot currently determine the dollar amount of the royalty obligations we will be required to pay on sales of future products, if any, the amounts may be substantial.","paraphrase":"Also, although we are presently unable to quantify the royalties we might owe on future product sales, if any such products are developed, those royalties could be large.","different_hard":"In addition, while we can currently determine the dollar amount of the royalty obligations we will be required to pay on sales of future products, if any, the amounts will be insignificant."},
{"id":"ka0129","verbatim":"Further increasing our exposure to this risk, we may not be able to replace our reserves or generate cash flows if we are unable to raise funds.","paraphrase":"Adding to this exposure, if we cannot obtain new capital, we might fail to replace our reserves or to generate cash flows.","different_hard":"Further reducing our exposure to this risk, we may be able to replace our reserves and generate cash flows even if we are unable to raise capital."},
{"id":"ka0130","verbatim":"We currently do not have key person life insurance on our officers and even if we seek to obtain this insurance may be unable to obtain such insurance in the coming months due to high cost or other reasons.","paraphrase":"At present we hold no key person life insurance on our officers, and even if we attempt to acquire such coverage, we may be unable to do so in the near term because of high premiums or other factors.","different_hard":"We currently have key person life insurance on our officers and, if we seek to obtain additional insurance, we expect to be able to obtain such insurance in the near future at reasonable cost."},
{"id":"ka0131","verbatim":"Statements in this filing, which express “belief,” “anticipation” or “expectation,” as well as other statements which are not historical facts, are forward-looking statements within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933, or Securities Act, and Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, or Exchange Act.","paraphrase":"Forward-looking statements within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933 (the Securities Act) and Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (the Exchange Act) include statements in this report that express “belief,” “anticipation” or “expectation,” along with other statements that are not historical facts.","different_hard":"Statements in this report, which express “belief,” “anticipation” or “expectation,” as well as other statements which are not historical facts, are not forward-looking statements within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933, or Securities Act, and Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, or Exchange Act."},
{"id":"ka0132","verbatim":"Gains and losses on the sale of loans are recorded in other non-interest income.","paraphrase":"Other non-interest income reflects any gains or losses realized when loans are sold.","different_hard":"Gains and losses on the sale of loans are excluded from other non-interest income."},
{"id":"ka0133","verbatim":"We are no longer required or allowed to amortize goodwill reflected on our balance sheet.","paraphrase":"Goodwill shown on our balance sheet is not subject to amortization, as we are neither required nor permitted to amortize it.","different_hard":"We are still required to amortize goodwill reflected on our balance sheet."},
{"id":"ka0134","verbatim":"We also expect the other laws and regulations affecting our commodities business to increase in both breadth and complexity.","paraphrase":"We further anticipate that the remaining statutes and rules governing our commodities operations will grow both broader and more intricate.","different_hard":"We also expect the other laws and regulations affecting our commodities business to decrease in both scope and complexity."},
{"id":"ka0135","verbatim":"It has also resulted in our voluntarily waiving fees on certain money market mutual funds and related distribution fees in order to prevent our clients’ yields on such funds from turning negative.","paraphrase":"This has also led us to voluntarily waive fees on certain money market mutual funds and related distribution fees, so that our clients’ yields on those funds do not turn negative.","different_hard":"It has also resulted in our voluntarily waiving fees on certain money market mutual funds and related distribution fees in order to allow our clients’ yields on such funds to become negative."},
{"id":"ka0136","verbatim":"The extent of coverage of modified pool products differs.","paraphrase":"How much coverage modified pool products provide is not uniform.","different_hard":"The extent of coverage of modified pool products is uniform."},
{"id":"ka0137","verbatim":"In turn, the success of our 8x8 voice and video communications services rests, among other things, upon future demand for VoIP telephony systems and services.","paraphrase":"Accordingly, whether our 8x8 voice and video communications services succeed depends, among other factors, on future demand for VoIP telephony systems and services.","different_hard":"In turn, the success of our 8x8 voice and video communications services depends, among other things, upon future demand for analog telephony systems and services."},
{"id":"ka0138","verbatim":"Broker-dealers who sell penny stocks must provide purchasers of these stocks with a uniform risk-disclosure document prepared by the SEC.","paraphrase":"Before selling penny stocks, broker-dealers are required to give buyers a uniform risk disclosure document that was prepared by the SEC.","different_hard":"Broker-dealers who sell penny stocks are exempt from providing purchasers of these stocks with a standardized risk-disclosure document prepared by the SEC."},
{"id":"ka0139","verbatim":"Alternative storage technologies exist, many of which require substantially less space than paper documents.","paraphrase":"Other storage technologies are available, and a large number of them take up far less room than paper records.","different_hard":"Alternative storage technologies exist, many of which require significantly more space than paper documents."},
{"id":"ka0140","verbatim":"Failure to innovate may adversely impact our market position and may adversely impact our product revenues.","paraphrase":"If we fail to innovate, our competitive standing may be harmed, and our product sales may suffer as well.","different_hard":"Failure to innovate may adversely impact our competitive position but will not impact our product revenues."},
{"id":"ka0141","verbatim":"The Company’s unrecognized tax benefits were $1.4 million and $3.6 million as of December 31, 2010 and 2009, respectively.","paraphrase":"Unrecognized tax benefits held by the Company totaled $1.1 million at December 31, 2009 and $3.1 million at December 31, 2008.","different_hard":"The Company’s unrecognized tax benefits were $3.1 million and $1.1 million as of December 31, 2009 and 2008, respectively."},
{"id":"ka0142","verbatim":"In addition, at the time of Merix’ acquisition of its subsidiary, Merix Asia Limited (“Merix Asia”), in March 2006, Merix Asia had an inadequate system of internal control over financial reporting and needed to develop processes to strengthen its accounting systems and control environment.","paraphrase":"Also, when Merix acquired its subsidiary Merix Asia Limited (“Merix Asia”) in September 2005, Merix Asia’s internal control over financial reporting was deficient, and it had to build processes to improve its accounting systems and control environment.","different_hard":"In addition, at the time of Merix’ acquisition of its subsidiary, Merix Asia Limited (“Merix Asia”), in September 2005, Merix Asia had a strong system of internal control over financial reporting and did not need to develop processes to strengthen its accounting systems and control environment."},
{"id":"ka0143","verbatim":"Our obligation to make interest payments to the trust on the debentures is subordinated to current liabilities or additional debt we may incur.","paraphrase":"Our duty to pay interest on the debentures to the trust ranks junior to our current liabilities and any further borrowings we may take on.","different_hard":"Our obligation to make interest payments to the trust on the debentures is senior to existing liabilities or additional debt we may incur."},
{"id":"ka0144","verbatim":"Among numerous other requirements is the requirement under Section 404(a) of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act for management to report on our internal controls over financial reporting and the requirement under Section 404(b) of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act for our registered independent public accountant to attest to this report.","paraphrase":"Included among numerous other obligations are Section 404(a) of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act, which requires management to report on our internal control over financial reporting, and Section 404(b), which requires our registered independent public accountant to attest to that report.","different_hard":"Among many other requirements is the requirement under Section 404(a) of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act for management to report on our internal controls over financial reporting and the requirement under Section 404(b) of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act for our registered independent public accountant to be exempt from attesting to this report."},
{"id":"ka0145","verbatim":"We are occasionally subject to claims due to the injury or death of a pet in our stores or while in our custody.","paraphrase":"From time to time, claims are brought against us over the injury or death of a pet that occurs in one of our stores or while the animal is in our care.","different_hard":"We are never subject to claims due to the injury or death of a pet in our stores or while under our care."},
{"id":"ka0146","verbatim":"If sales do not meet expectations, too much inventory may reduce planned margins.","paraphrase":"Should sales fall short of what we expect, excess inventory could push our margins below what we planned.","different_hard":"If sales do not meet expectations, too little inventory may lower planned margins."},
{"id":"ka0147","verbatim":"Consequently, we cannot assure ourselves of a supply of motion pictures by entering into long-term arrangements with leading distributors, but must compete for our licenses on a film-by-film and theatre-by-theatre basis.","paraphrase":"For that reason, we are unable to secure a steady supply of motion pictures through long-term agreements with major distributors and instead must bid for our licenses film by film and theatre by theatre.","different_hard":"Consequently, we can assure ourselves of a supply of motion pictures by entering into long-term arrangements with major distributors, and need not compete for our licenses on a film-by-film and theatre-by-theatre basis."},
{"id":"ka0148","verbatim":"Securities analysts of major brokerage firms may not provide coverage of our Company since there is no incentive to brokerage firms to recommend the purchase of common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the “Common Stock”).","paraphrase":"Analysts at large brokerage houses might decline to cover our Company, because brokerage firms have no incentive to recommend buying common stock, par value $0.001 per share (the “Common Stock”).","different_hard":"Securities analysts of major brokerage firms are likely to provide coverage of our Company since there is a strong incentive to brokerage firms to recommend the purchase of common stock, par value $0.001 per share (the “Common Stock”)."},
{"id":"ka0149","verbatim":"Such a failure could occur for many different reasons.","paraphrase":"Such a failure could be caused by a wide range of factors.","different_hard":"Such a failure could not occur for any number of reasons."}
